meta.title: Contact Teknoppy | Web Design & SEO Agency, Kochi Kerala
meta.description: Contact Teknoppy for website design, SEO, and digital marketing in Kochi, Kerala. Serving clients across India and the GCC (UAE, Qatar). Get a reply within one business day.

hero.intro: Have a project in mind, or just need a straight answer about your website or SEO? Send us the details below and a Teknoppy strategist will get back to you within one business day — not a generic auto-reply, an actual answer from someone who read your message.

form.heading: Send Us the Details
form.successMessage: Thanks — your message is with us. A Teknoppy strategist will reply within one business day.
form.errorMessage: Something went wrong sending your message. Please call +91 6282249224 or email sanal@teknoppy.com and we'll pick it up straight away.

whereWeWork.heading: Where We Work
whereWeWork.html: Teknoppy takes on projects across Kerala — Kochi, Thrissur, Kozhikode, Trivandrum — and works with businesses in the UAE and Qatar through our GCC team. Time zone difference isn't a problem; most GCC calls happen in the morning IST, which lines up with UAE and Qatar business hours. Whether you're a small Kochi business needing a first website or a Gulf-based company redesigning an existing one, the process starts the same way — a short conversation before any commitment.

paragraphs.text: Tell us what you need — a new website, an SEO audit, ongoing marketing — and roughly what you're working with. That's enough for us to reply with next steps instead of another form to fill out. If it's a good fit, we'll set up a short call to scope the work properly before any quote goes out.

paragraphs.html: Not ready for a call yet? Start with a free website audit or book a consultation directly.

faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions

items.q: How fast does Teknoppy reply to enquiries?
items.a: Within one business day, usually sooner during the week.

items.q: Does Teknoppy take on clients outside India?
items.a: Yes — we actively work with businesses in the UAE and Qatar, alongside clients across Kerala.
Yes. The first call is free and there's no obligation to proceed afterward.

items.q: What should I include in my message?
items.a: What you need (website, SEO, or both), your current site if you have one, and a rough timeline. That's enough for us to give a useful first reply.

items.q: Do you only build websites, or handle SEO too?
items.a: Both, under one team — see the full list on our Services page.

items.q: Can I speak to someone before signing anything?
items.a: Yes. Every project starts with a free call, no commitment required until you're ready.

faq.footnoteHtml: See our certifications and client reviews → before you reach out, if you'd like proof first.

devNotes.napConflict: This doc states the office as "Vyttila, Kochi, Kerala, India" and also requires the NAP to be character-for-character identical to the Google Business Profile and the site footer. The footer and site.json use the fuller "Kaithakal Building, Near Thykoodam Metro, Vyttila PO, Kochi, Kerala 682019". Page copy renders as this doc states; the two must be reconciled against the live GBP listing before launch.
devNotes.brandColourConflict: Designer notes specify orange #FF8C00. The site's brand token is #F05A2C and public/logo.svg uses #D84315. Buttons use the existing site token — three different oranges are in play and need a decision.
requiresClientInput: Form endpoint — submissions are not delivered anywhere until PUBLIC_CONTACT_ENDPOINT is set. No CRM/inbox routing, no auto-email to the enquirer.
reCAPTCHA v3 site key — invisible spam protection not implemented.
Analytics — no GA4/GTM on the site, so form, phone-click and WhatsApp-click conversion events cannot be tracked yet.
Real office/team photo near the contact block.
Confirmed certification badges (Google Partner etc.) for the trust badge row.
Organization schema sameAs — LinkedIn / social / Google Business Profile URLs are still "#" in site.json.
